title: From Cherry to Cup

lines.text: Every cup of coffee starts as a cherry.
lines.spoken: Every cup of coffee starts as a cherry.

lines.text: It grows on a shrub, in a band around the equator called the Coffee Belt.
lines.spoken: It grows on a shrub, in a band around the equator called the Coffee Belt.

lines.text: Pickers take the ripe cherries, and the fruit is washed or dried away.

lines.text: The green seed inside is roasted at around 200 degrees.
lines.spoken: The green seed inside is roasted at around two hundred degrees.
